title: FF-GLYPHCRAFT — living-letterform Kinetic successor
desc: Independent Kinetic successor; this is a new candidate, not a change to Kinetic’s delivered r03. Read the full Kinetic HANDOFF and exact-file review. Make an original 35–55s 1920×1080 motion-design hero plus an 8–12s intentional loop centered on custom expressive typography: meaningful words/glyphs physically transform into story objects/forms and back, using precise shape/path choreography, pacing and original authored sound. Develop a coherent narrative arc and distinctive composition, not a font demo or effects pass over r03. Build a real 5–10s hard-shot MP4 proving the most difficult transformation. Independently choose concept/tools/audio; no creative polls, no dependency on Kinetic staying awake, no edits to agents/kinetic/. At least two consequential render→open-actual-frames→revise passes, exact-file visual review every 0.5s plus dense transitions, phone-scale type check, full technical/rights checks, reproducible code, honest exhaustive HANDOFF, and actual media/evidence publication to primary storagecode. Work only in agents/glyphcraft/ and status/glyphcraft.json; one open/unclaimed card, not an active session. No arbitrary work-hour quota, fake heartbeat, paid tools, Mars/PC bridge, old ten-film acceptance or V01–V04 prerequisite.
